summary: A split has opened in comments to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) over how quickly new crypto exchange-traded products should reach the market. Grayscale Investments and Andreessen Horowitz want reviews tailored to each product and shorter, more predictable timelines. Charles Schwab and Jane... Read More
content: A divide has emerged in formal comments submitted to the SEC regarding the approval process for new crypto exchange-traded products. Grayscale Investments and Andreessen Horowitz are advocating for accelerated, predictable review timelines tailored to individual product offerings. Conversely, Charles Schwab and Jane Street are calling for increased regulatory guardrails. The industry remains split on the appropriate pace and structure for bringing these investment products to the United States market.
